notes: Format documented by Luminys itself: rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/video/livemedia?Ch=<channel>&Streamtype=<type>. Ch = channel number starting from 1 (Ch=1 on a single-sensor camera; on a recorder, the channel of the camera). Streamtype=0 is the main stream, Streamtype=1 the sub stream; the official documents describe no value for a third stream, so none is listed. Default RTSP port 554 (may be omitted when default). Credentials can be embedded in the URL or supplied by the client when it prompts. The Luminys Wiki article states the format for Luminys devices in general; the Network Camera User Manual Rev. 1 (linked from the N3/N4/N5/N9 camera product pages) and the LPR Camera User Manual Rev. 1 (N9L) print the same format. The N2 series product pages and the LumiCloud camera manual (N5x-…C models) do not restate the URL, although their datasheets list RTSP as a supported protocol.
